requirements.fretish: HerGoals whenever strategy_code = 0 shall immediately satisfy same_episode & selected_step > current_step.
HerGoals whenever strategy_code = 1 shall immediately satisfy same_episode & selected_step = last_step.
HerGoals whenever strategy_code = 2 shall immediately satisfy same_episode.

variables.meaning: Current transition's episode-relative step position, not its circular buffer index.

variables.name: last_step
variables.meaning: Episode-relative position of the final achieved goal.

variables.meaning: Episode-relative position at which the returned goal was achieved.

variables.name: same_episode
variables.meaning: Returned achieved goal belongs to the indexed transition's episode.

explanation.text:
SCOPE: in the interval defined by the entire execution.
TRIGGER: every point in the interval where (strategy_code = 0) is true.
REQUIRED BEHAVIOR: for every trigger, if trigger holds then (same_episode & selected_step > current_step) also holds at the same time point.
